cpu_emulation_of_ci_configuration.note: Model::Llvmpipe composed with the pre-fix shader semantics (zero-coverage fragments still blend), compared with exact arithmetic by the previous metric. rsqrt estimates in llvmpipe's encoder are not emulated.

diagnosis: Reference-test defect: the oracle assumed exact bilinear filtering and exact, unquantized sRGB blending and used a fixed code tolerance. llvmpipe filters the R8 atlas in 8-bit fixed point and converts sRGB with polynomials between blends; near black the sRGB curve magnifies a 1/255 coverage step to 4-8 codes. Geometry, clipping and opacity were not wrong. Secondary rendering issue: zero-coverage fragments still blended, so a non-identity sRGB round trip perturbed uncovered pixels on llvmpipe.

source_patch.shader: discard fragments whose alpha is zero
source_patch.reference: Model::Portable admitted code intervals: TAP 1/255 (+1/255 off the 1/256 grid) for glyph taps between texel centres, exact on texel centres or equal texels; DECODE 0.5, ENCODE 0.67 per blend; UNORM read exactly
source_patch.tests: four GPU draw tests assert zero channels outside; new CPU test admits Exact and emulated llvmpipe candidates and rejects wrong geometry, opacity, clip
